description: This file contains the implementation of the Interbase (IBASE) database driver for the ADOdb PHP database abstraction layer. It defines classes for database connection management, transaction handling, metadata retrieval, blob handling, and SQL dialect-specific functions tailored for Interbase/Firebird databases.

classes.name: ADODB_ibase
classes.description: Represents the Interbase database driver, handling connections, transactions, metadata, blob operations, and SQL dialect functions specific to Interbase/Firebird databases.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ibase
classes.description: Implements recordset handling for Interbase, supporting row fetching, field info, and result set operations.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent or non-persistent connection to the Interbase database using specified hostname, username, password, and database name.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the Interbase database, reusing existing connections if available.

methods.name: MetaPrimaryKeys
methods.description: Retrieves primary key columns for a specified table.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns information about the connected Interbase server, including dialect version and description.

methods.name: _Execute
methods.description: Executes an SQL statement, possibly with input parameters.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a query and returns the result resource or true for affected rows.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection, rolling back ongoing transactions if necessary.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the columns of a specified table.

methods.name: BlobEncode
methods.description: Encodes a binary large object into a database blob resource.

methods.name: BlobDecode
methods.description: Decodes a blob retrieved from the database into a PHP string.

methods.name: UpdateBlobFile
methods.description: Updates a blob column by reading data from a file.

methods.name: UpdateBlob
methods.description: Updates a blob column with a given binary string, handling chunked data transfer.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Formats a date according to a specified string format for SQL queries.
